{{Navbar-GOGPT-tracker}}
'''U-Thai power station''' (โรงไฟฟ้าอุทัย) is an operating power station of at least 1600-megawatts (MW) in Uthai, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, Thailand.
It is also known as GUT Power station Rojana Industrial ParkUthai District.
